name: Tsutsumi Jewelry Co.,Ltd.
summary: Tsutsumi Jewelry Co.,Ltd. manufactures, wholesales, and retails jewelry in Japan. The company offers rings, pinky ring, earrings, necklace, pendant necklace, bridal ring, bracelet, and other accessories. It offers its products under the Blessed Rain, Pure Planets, Winter Collection, and Winter Limited brands. The company was formerly known as Tsutsumi Precious Metals and Crafts Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tsutsumi Jewelry Co., Ltd. in April 1988. Tsutsumi Jewelry Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Warabi, Japan.
